NewsArticle.Title: Web Service
NewsArticle.Content: Web service interrupted. We are investigating and fixing [www.darkages.com](http://www.darkages.com/). In the interim use "[www1.darkages.com](http://www1.darkages.com/)" address. Online registration services are temporarily unavailable. Registration actions may be delayed several hours. Estimated time of fix is a few days right now. Check back for updates in a few days. Game server is unaffected. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, [test your connection.](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm)
